digest.component_or_area: Backend port / Jira reconciler transport abstraction
propositions: DC transport raises JIRAError which does not match existing urllib.error.HTTPError catch clauses in core reconciler modules, causing exceptions to escape instead of being handled.
Deletion detection in outbound_differ._safe_get_issue fails silently on DC because JIRAError(404) is not caught and mapped to _DELETED like Cloud's HTTPError(404).
Reporter modification in dispatch_apply_phases fails to degrade softly on DC because JIRAError(4xx) escapes the existing HTTPError catch clause instead of being recorded as permission denied.
BackendHTTPError declared as port exception contract, subclassing urllib.error.HTTPError to preserve .code attribute and compatibility with existing catch sites.
DC transport translates JIRAError to BackendHTTPError at adapter boundary (_with_connection_retry), making the exception visible to core without core edits.
Cloud transport remains unmodified and continues raising urllib.error.HTTPError, which is caught by the same BackendHTTPError parent class relationship.
